name: project-init
description: Scaffold how a project is run under Orca and oh-my-claudecode (the operating model, the worker roster, the workstream register, the worker brief) and report to the owner on a live status board.

board_link_row.title: Board link above the prompt
board_link_row.description: Show the status board's short address as a row above the prompt, in a session of a project that has a board. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later. On unless you turn it off.

board_link_status_line.title: Board link in the status line
board_link_status_line.description: Show the board's address in your status line. Off until you set it up with /project-init:board-link, which edits nothing without your yes. The row above the prompt comes back by itself if the status line stops showing the link.
